# Programs 9 summer 2027 intern postings and 1 busy-season tax internship, plus SC&H's three-day sophomore Externship (January 2027), which isn't an internship


*Last updated: November 2026*


SC&H's summer 2027 internships are open now, and so are two nearer programs. On October 12, 2026, the firm's[job board](https://recruiting.ultipro.com/SCH1020SCHG/JobBoard/32dd4149-e41d-45e4-afe3-e24f7220d3bf/) listed **nine Summer 2027 intern postings** , all dated September 7, 2026: Risk, Consultant, Enterprise Advisory & Transformation, two Technology tracks, Capital, Special Situations in two cities, and Wealth. It also listed a 2027 Busy Season Tax Intern role that runs January to mid-April 2027, and SC&H's own three-day Externship for sophomores in January 2027. Every internship posting states the same pay, $30 to $35 an hour.


In plain words: you apply from September 2026 and intern in summer 2027, starting the Monday after Memorial Day. Applications are rolling with no deadline. The summer program lasts ten weeks on a four-day week of about 30 to 32 hours.


---


## What Is an SC&H Internship?


An SC&H internship is a paid, in-person position at SC&H Group, a 100% employee-owned accounting, consulting, technology, investment banking and wealth firm headquartered in Hunt Valley (Sparks), Maryland, north of Baltimore. The firm was founded in 1991 as a regional audit and tax practice and now describes itself as "430+ professionals" across 13 practices. Summer interns join one service line for ten weeks and work on client projects with a dedicated mentor. Vault ranks the program #3 on its[2026 Best Consulting Internships list](https://vault.com/best-internships-rankings-search/best-internships-by-industry/consulting) and lists the class at 21 to 50 interns. The summer week is four days and about 30 to 32 hours, and the firm says it doesn't offer a full 40-hour week to interns. Offices are in Maryland, Tysons Corner, Philadelphia and Chicago.


## When Do SC&H Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


SC&H posted its nine Summer 2027 intern roles on September 7, 2026. The firm's Early Careers page says the internship "begins the Monday after Memorial Day", which we read as June 7, 2027, so the lead time is about nine months. Two shorter-lead programs sit alongside it. The 2027 Busy Season Tax Intern role was posted October 8, 2026 for a January 2027 start, about three months ahead. SC&H's sophomore Externship was posted September 22, 2026 for three days in January 2027, and the firm says those positions are posted "each fall". Applications for summer 2028 are expected to open in early September 2027. That projection rests on one dated cycle, so treat it as an estimate.

### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


SC&H's hiring is **rolling** . None of the ten internship postings has a closing date. The firm's entry on Vault says "Applications are accepted on a rolling basis until all positions are filled", and its own FAQ adds that it recruits year-round for its service lines. Year-round doesn't mean unlimited. Vault lists the summer class at 21 to 50 interns, spread across nine postings, so some service lines may have only a few seats. The summer roles have been open since September 7, and most of the firm's fall campus events have already happened. A seat that's filled in October won't be there in January. Apply to your service line now, and treat the busy-season tax role as urgent because it starts in January.

SC&H's Externship is a separate program, not an internship: three days on site each January for 25 sophomores, with a one-time $550 stipend. ## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


The rules come from the ten internship postings and the firm's Early Careers FAQ:


• **Class year:** the firm says internships are "available to Juniors & Seniors in college". Its student programs begin in sophomore year with the Externship.


• **GPA:** 3.4 or above for Risk, Consultant, Enterprise Advisory & Transformation and Busy Season Tax. 3.6 or above for Capital, Special Situations and Wealth. The two Technology postings don't state a GPA.


• **Major:** business-related majors on most tracks. Risk names finance or information systems, the Technology postings name business, technology or engineering, and tax names accounting or finance.


• **Experience:** seven postings ask for "previous successful business experience" and Microsoft Office proficiency.


• **Documents:** a resume and your most recent unofficial transcript.


• **Work authorization:** the firm's FAQ says it's "unable to consider candidates that require sponsorship either now or in the future including those that are OPT or CPT eligible".


• **Location:** in person, with reliable transportation to the service line's office.


### Is the GPA a Hard Cutoff at SC&H?


It's written as one. The postings say "GPA of 3.4 or above" or "GPA of 3.6 or above" in the requirements list, and one says "a minimum GPA of 3.4". None uses the word preferred, and the application asks for a transcript. The split matters: the investment banking and wealth tracks set the higher bar. Vault's profile shows a 3.5 to 3.99 band and juniors only, which doesn't match the postings, so go by the postings. The sponsorship rule is the other firm line. It covers externs, interns and new staff, and it names OPT and CPT.

## What Skills Does SC&H Look For, and How Do You Build Them?


All ten internship postings ask for **communication and interpersonal skills** and **attention to detail** . Eight share one skills block: "superb verbal communication, business writing, and interpersonal skills" and "excellent analytical, organization, and project management skills". Seven want **Microsoft Office** proficiency and prior business experience, and the two Special Situations postings name Excel and PowerPoint. Track-specific asks are lighter on tools. Interns surveyed by Vault fill that in: they report interview questions on Excel and SQL, and for the banking tracks, "three financial statements, valuation methods, and a case study". One advisory intern worked in OneStream on a client dashboard mock-up.

## What Is the SC&H Application and Interview Process Like?


SC&H publishes four steps on its Early Careers page, and interns surveyed by Vault describe the interviews:


1. **Apply for a position.** Apply online to one service line's posting with a resume and your most recent unofficial transcript. The firm says a career fair conversation doesn't replace the online application.


2. **Resume review.** Talent Acquisition reviews applications and contacts the candidates it wants to advance.


3. **Interview with the team.** Interviews are with leaders from your chosen service line, online or in person. Interns describe two 30-minute conversations.


4. **Receive an offer.** Interns report hearing back a few weeks after the second interview.


Reported questions include a difficult team situation and your Excel and SQL knowledge. Banking candidates also got the three financial statements, valuation methods and a short case. Our[behavioral interview guide](https://www.extern.com/post/behavioral-interview-questions-star-method-guide) covers the conversational half.

## How Do You Stand Out for an SC&H Internship?


Three moves. **First, choose the service line before you apply.** Each track is its own posting with its own interviewers, and one surveyed intern wished they'd researched the other service lines more. **Second, check the gate for that track.** It's a 3.4 GPA for risk, consulting and tax and a 3.6 for Capital, Special Situations and Wealth, with a transcript attached and no sponsorship of any kind. **Third, prepare for the track's interview.** Most are conversational. The banking tracks add the three financial statements and valuation methods, so practice those out loud. On offers, SC&H declines to give a number. Its FAQ says "a significant number of our interns come back to join us as full-time employees" and that conversion varies with class size and business needs. It publishes no applicant count.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2027 SC&H internship?


Yes. On October 12, 2026, SC&H's job board listed nine Summer 2027 intern postings: Risk, Consultant, Enterprise Advisory & Transformation, two Technology tracks, Capital, Special Situations in Columbia and Chicago, and Wealth. All were posted September 7, 2026, and none has a deadline. Applications are rolling until positions are filled.


### When do SC&H internship applications open for summer 2028?


Applications for summer 2028 are expected to open in early September 2027, about nine months before the program starts. That's projected from this cycle, when all nine summer 2027 postings went up on September 7, 2026. SC&H hasn't announced a date, and it says it recruits year-round for its service lines.


### How much do SC&H interns get paid?


Every SC&H internship posting states $30.00 to $35.00 an hour, including the nine summer 2027 roles and the busy-season tax role, in Maryland, Virginia and Chicago alike. Interns also get four days of PTO. The firm says interns aren't eligible for health benefits, and it doesn't offer a 40-hour week.


### What GPA do you need for an SC&H internship?


It depends on the track. Risk, Consultant, Enterprise Advisory & Transformation and Busy Season Tax ask for a 3.4 or above. Capital, Special Situations and Wealth ask for a 3.6 or above. The two Technology postings don't state a GPA. The application asks for your most recent unofficial transcript.


### What is the SC&H Externship, and is it the same as an Extern Externship?


No, they're different programs. SC&H's Externship is a three-day, on-site program each January for 25 college sophomores, with a $550 stipend, and it can lead to an SC&H internship the following summer. An Extern Externship is a separate, remote, multi-week project program run by Extern, with no affiliation with SC&H.


### How long is the SC&H internship and when does it start?


The summer internship is ten weeks, from June to August, and begins the Monday after Memorial Day, which we expect to be June 7, 2027. After a five-day orientation week, interns work in person four days a week for about 30 to 32 hours. The firm prefers at least eight weeks.


### Does SC&H sponsor visas for interns?


No. SC&H's Early Careers FAQ says it's unable to consider candidates who require sponsorship now or in the future, including students who are OPT or CPT eligible. The rule applies to externs, interns and incoming staff. The firm also says its student programs are offered at its US offices only.


### Do SC&H interns get full-time offers?


SC&H doesn't publish a conversion rate. Its FAQ says a significant number of interns come back as full-time employees and that rates vary year to year with class size and business needs. Offers to graduating seniors depend on performance, fit and budget. Vault ranks the program #37 for employment prospects.


SC&H's summer 2027 postings are open and rolling, so apply to your service line this month. For interview material, a[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) from Extern (not to be confused with SC&H's three-day sophomore program) gives you a finished modeling or strategy project to discuss.
